### Props

| Name               | Type      | Required | Default                                 | Description                                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------ | --------- | -------- | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `allowTyped`       | `boolean` |          | `true`                                  | Allow typed (text-input) signatures. When both `allowTyped` and `allowDrawn` are true the user picks via a radio group; when only one is true the picker is hidden. |
| `allowDrawn`       | `boolean` |          | `true`                                  | Allow drawn (canvas) signatures.                                                                                                                                    |
| `initialMode`      | `string`  |          | `'typed'`                               | Initial / preferred mode when both are allowed.                                                                                                                     |
| `affirmation`      | `string`  |          | `''`                                    | Optional affirmation text rendered next to a checkbox the user must tick (the `affirmed` field in the emit payload). Empty string hides the checkbox.               |
| `canvasWidth`      | `number`  |          | `360`                                   | Canvas dimensions. The PNG data-URL emitted on `change` uses these.                                                                                                 |
| `canvasHeight`     | `number`  |          | `120`                                   | Canvas height.                                                                                                                                                      |
| `lineWidth`        | `number`  |          | `2`                                     | Line width for drawn signatures.                                                                                                                                    |
| `strokeColor`      | `string`  |          | `'#000'`                                | Stroke colour (CSS colour string).                                                                                                                                  |
| `typedFont`        | `string`  |          | `'"Brush Script MT", cursive'`          | Font family used for the typed-signature preview.                                                                                                                   |
| `typedPlaceholder` | `string`  |          | `'Type your name'`                      | Placeholder for the typed input + preview when empty.                                                                                                               |
| `typedAriaLabel`   | `string`  |          | `'Typed signature input'`               | ARIA label for the typed input.                                                                                                                                     |
| `drawnAriaLabel`   | `string`  |          | `'Drawn signature canvas'`              | ARIA label for the canvas.                                                                                                                                          |
| `drawnHint`        | `string`  |          | `'Draw your signature inside the box.'` | Hint text under the canvas.                                                                                                                                         |
| `typedModeLabel`   | `string`  |          | `'Type'`                                | Label for the typed mode radio.                                                                                                                                     |
| `drawnModeLabel`   | `string`  |          | `'Draw'`                                | Label for the drawn mode radio.                                                                                                                                     |
| `clearLabel`       | `string`  |          | `'Clear'`                               | Clear-button label.                                                                                                                                                 |

### Events

| Name     | Payload | Description                                                                                                                                                                              |
| -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `change` | —       | Emitted on every state mutation (typed input, stroke end, mode switch, affirmation toggle, clear). Consumers persist the latest payload; partial captures are valid intermediate states. |
